headline: Nevish Line Flares as Fisherman's Row Changes Hands
war_summary: Fresh wires put the Nevish Line and Fisherman's Row at the head of the late fighting, with six changes in two hours around Tomb Father, Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way and four at Oceanwatch, the whole of that front's day total falling inside the last two hours, while Linn Mercy stirs anew with three in two hours around Outwich Ranch and Lathair after its earlier lull. Weathered Expanse adds a single late change amid twenty-nine in the day around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, now listed at seven Warden holds to two neutral. By contrast Godcrofts, Palantine Berm, Marban Hollow, Farranac Coast, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle record no change in the last two hours despite heavy day totals, Godcrofts holding forty-six around Isawa and Fleecewatch and now listed at nine Colonial posts. Callahan's Passage and the Deadlands again report the heaviest casualty lists, near twenty-seven hundred Colonial and eighteen hundred Warden losses in two hours in the former and above twenty-one hundred Warden losses in the latter, without a single ownership flip in the day.
